title: ci: introduce epoched premerge runner and dependency parity shim
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: our presubmit lanes suffer from noisy long-running flakes when dependency graph churn interacts with heavyweight integration runners. This patch introduces an "epoched" premerge runner model (deterministic lightweight fastpath + epoched slow validators) and a small compatibility shim that enforces dependency parity between the premerge environment and release images. Goals: reduce presubmit latency for small changes, avoid blind merges due to transient dep mismatches, and provide a guarded slow validator for determinism-sensitive tests.

What this PR does: - Adds a new presubmit runner mode (epoched) that separates quick semantic checks from slower environment-sensitive validations. Quick checks run on fast ephemeral runners; slow validators are scheduled in epoch windows to batch resource usage. - Introduces a dep-parity shim: a thin tool that captures resolved dependency snapshots for the epoch and validates that release artifact images resolve the same snapshot (fail-fast on drift). - Refactors existing lint/test pipeline orchestration to allow conditional short-circuiting and explicit requeueing for epoch validators. - Adds a lightweight release gate that prevents automatic merges when epoch parity check fails; maintainers can override with documented sleigh reasons.

Checklist:
- [x] implement epoched runner orchestration and scheduler hook
- [x] implement dep-parity shim and snapshot serializer
- [x] integrate with presubmit dashboards and telemetry
- [x] update docs: presubmit.md and release-gates.md
- [x] add smoke tests for epoch gating and parity failures

Related links: Linear ENG-1428 (presubmit latency), ENG-1435 (release parity incidents). See RFC: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1428/epoched-presubmit-runner (internal).

Commit summary: this description lists commits at a high level. The branch contains incremental commits that implement the shim, the scheduler, tests, docs updates, and a cleanup squash at the end.

CI notes: initial run had one flaky unit test in pkg/runner that required a timing guard; rerun fixed it. All checks passing at merge.

Merging strategy: squash and merge to keep history readable and ensure dep snapshot commit is singular for backfilling in release artifacts.

release_notes:
- Introduce epoched premerge runner: fastpath + epoch validators to reduce presubmit latency.
- Add dependency parity shim to detect resolver drift between presubmit and release images.
- New telemetry for fastpath short-circuiting and parity failures.
- Docs updated for presubmit behavior and release gate workflow.
